steps.en: Install the desktop app, a reviewed extension and its weights
steps.zh: 安装桌面应用、审查过的扩展及权重

steps.en: Connect Image, Generate Mesh and Add to Scene
steps.zh: 连接图片、生成网格和加入场景节点

steps.en: Select the workflow and generate from an input image
steps.zh: 选择工作流并从输入图片生成

steps.en: Run the selected generator and add its mesh to the workspace
steps.zh: 运行选定生成器并把网格加入工作区

value.en: Create a draft 3D asset without operating each model demo separately
value.zh: 不用逐个运行模型演示，就能生成三维资产草稿
